'''Landry Michael Shamet''' (born March 13, 1997) is an American basketball player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Wichita State Shockers men's basketball|Wichita State Shockers]]. The [[shooting guard]] played just three games in his [[Redshirt (college sports)|redshirt]] freshman year and attended [[Park Hill High School]] in [[Kansas City, Missouri]], where he was a student in the Advancement via Individual Determination (AVID) college preparatory program. 

Shamet played three games in his freshman season before having to redshirt the season due to a foot injury. In January 2017, he became the point guard for the Shockers.<ref name="Suellentrop">{{cite news|last1=Paul|first1=Suellentrop|title=Wichita State’s Landry Shamet taking first steps on national stage|url=http://www.kansas.com/sports/college/wichita-state/article139419493.html|accessdate=December 7, 2017|work=[[The Wichita Eagle]]|date=March 18, 2017}}</ref> In his redshirt freshman season, Shamet averaged  11.4 points and 3.3 assists per game. He was named to the First team [[Missouri Valley Conference|MVC]] All-Conference and MVC Freshman of the Year. Following the season Shamet had surgery to repair a stress fracture on his foot.<ref name="rittenberg">{{cite news|last1=Rittenberg|first1=Adam|title=Landry Shamet scheduled for right foot surgery, out 12-16 weeks|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/20209587/landry-shamet-wichita-state-shockers-scheduled-right-foot-surgery-12-16-weeks|accessdate=December 7, 2017|work=[[ESPN]]|date=July 31, 2017}}</ref> 

Coming into his sophomore year, Shamet was named to the Preseason First Team All-AAC and was one of fifty players named in the Preseason Wooden Award watch list.<ref name="Preseason media">{{cite press release|url=http://www.theamerican.org/news/2017/10/13/MBB_1013171801.aspx?path=mbball|title=Cincinnati Selected as 2017–18 American Men's Basketball Preseason Favorite|publisher=American Athletic  |date=October 16, 2017|accessdate=October 16, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Shamet named to Naismith Watch List|url=http://www.kwch.com/content/sports/Shamet-named-to-Naismith-Watch-List-456464793.html|accessdate=December 7, 2017|work=KWCH12|date=November 9, 2017}}</ref> He was one of only two sophomores to be selected for the 2018 Wooden Award Midseason Top 25 list.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ncaa.com/news/basketball-men/article/2018-01-11/college-basketball-john-r-wooden-award-midseason-top-25|title=College basketball: John R. Wooden Award Midseason Top 25 announced|date=2018-01-11|work=NCAA.com|access-date=2018-02-20|language=en}}</ref> Shamet scored a career-high 30 points to help Wichita State beat Oklahoma State 78-66 on December 9, 2017.<ref>{{cite news|title=Shamet scores 30; No. 6 Wichita St. tops Oklahoma St. 78-66|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400988001|accessdate=December 9, 2017|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=December 9, 2017}}</ref> Shamet currently leads the AAC in several categories, including assists per game, true shooting percentage, and offensive box plus/minus.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/landry-shamet-1.html|title=Landry Shamet College Stats {{!}} College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com|website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com|language=en|access-date=2018-02-20}}</ref>
